items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Frank Fever's playing ghetto. He was the bass player.

ctx.x: What about Booker Washington? Did you ever know him?
I never knew him. We played in the last band together. That's the band, that's the guy you see in the Navy band. That's the bass player. Frank Fever's playing ghetto. He was the bass player.
Who played the Clannett in the Nola band? Who did you say, what's that, Arthur Williams?
